name: zenrows
description: Live web data for ChatGPT and Codex: read pages, extract structured data, run batch jobs and site crawls, and drive hosted browser sessions through the Zenrows MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Live web data from any page
interface.longDescription:
Zenrows lets ChatGPT and Codex read live web pages and turn them into usable data. Ask for a page's content and get clean markdown. Ask for products, prices, articles or tables and get structured fields. Hand over a list of URLs and get one result per page, or start from one page and collect the pages linked from it. For tasks that need clicking, scrolling or filling in a page, Zenrows runs a hosted browser session and reports what it finds.

Connect your Zenrows account once with secure sign-in. Usage counts against your Zenrows plan.
defaultPrompt: Get the product names and prices from https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/
List the pages linked from https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/

positive.description: Read one JavaScript-rendered page as markdown
positive.prompt: Get the content of https://www.scrapingcourse.com/javascript-rendering/ as markdown.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the rendered page as markdown, including the product names that load through JavaScript.

positive.description: Structured fields from a listing page
positive.prompt: Get the product names and prices from https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of the products on the page, each with its name and price.

positive.description: Several URLs as one batch job
positive.prompt: Get the title of each of these pages: https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/page/2/, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/pagination, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/table-parsing, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/javascript-rendering/
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one result per URL with its page title, and reports how many URLs succeeded and failed.

positive.prompt: Open https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/, go to the second page of results and list every product on it.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the products shown on page 2 of the catalog, then closes the browser session.

positive.prompt: How much of my Zenrows usage have I spent this period?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connected account's current usage and plan without changing anything.

negative.description: Request unrelated to web data: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: Purchase with card details: the plugin should decline to buy or to enter payment data
negative.prompt: Buy the first product on https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/ and pay with my card 4111 1111 1111 1111.

negative.description: No target URL: the plugin should ask which page to read before calling any tool

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Requests use credits on the user's existing Zenrows plan.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Connects ChatGPT and Codex to the hosted Zenrows MCP server with OAuth sign-in, and adds nine skills: using-zenrows, getting-started, scrape-webpage, extract-structured-data, batch, crawl, map, browser-automation and capture-api-calls.
